{{Quote|A good Neimoidian ''makes'' his opportunities.|The Neimoidian captain|<ref name="Hunting" />}}
A '''Neimoidian''' [[Gender/Legends|male]] served as the [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[Unidentified Munificent-class star frigate (Florrum)|''Munificent''-class star frigate]] patrolling near the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Florrum/Legends|Florrum]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Following [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane's]] [[Senate hostage crisis/Legends|rescue]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoner]] [[Ziro Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Ziro the Hutt]] on the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] circa [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], Bane's [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] accomplice, [[Shahan Alama/Legends|Shahan Alama]], took a [[Flarestar-class attack shuttle/Legends|''Flarestar''-class shuttle]] and headed for Florrum to escape from the Republic. The [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] captain ordered his [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|frigate]] to [[Battle of Florrum|open fire]] on Alama's craft and, moments later, had [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]] of [[Droid starfighter/Legends|droid starfighters]] deployed to combat a Republic [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i]] [[Gunship/Legends|gunship]] spotted in the area.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Captain, an unidentified vessel approaches.''"<br />"''More detail, Lieutenant. Your description does me no help!|A battle droid lieutenant and the Neimoidian captain|<ref name="Hunting" />}}
A [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] was the [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of a [[Unidentified Munificent-class star frigate (Florrum)|''Munificent''-class star frigate]] serving in the [[Confederate Navy/Legends|Navy]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="Hunting" /> Shortly after a group of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]], under the command of the [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]], [[Senate hostage crisis/Legends|rescued]] [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Ziro Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Ziro Desilijic Tiure]] from his imprisonment in the [[Republic Judiciary Central Detention Center/Legends|Republic Judiciary Central Detention Center]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]<ref name="Hostage">{{TCW|Hostage Crisis}}</ref> circa [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="SW Annual 2011">''[[Star Wars Annual 2011]]''</ref> the Neimoidian and his [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|frigate]] were patrolling a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] in which the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Florrum/Legends|Florrum]],<ref name="Hunting" /> home to a base of [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] [[Ohnaka Gang/Legends|pirates]],<ref name="Captured">{{TCW|Dooku Captured}}</ref> was located.<ref name="Hunting" />

[[File:UnidentifiedNeimoidian2-TCWHtHpt1.png|thumb|left|250px|The Neimoidian confers with his battle droid lieutenant.]]
The Neimoidian captain was informed by a [[OOM command battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] [[Unidentified OOM command battle droid lieutenant|lieutenant]] that an [[Shahan Alama's Flarestar-class attack shuttle|unidentified]] [[Flarestar-class attack shuttle/Legends|''Flarestar''-class shuttle]]&mdash;[[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] by the [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] [[Shahan Alama/Legends|Shahan Alama]], a member of the group that freed Ziro&mdash;was approaching their [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]]. Though the [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid's]] original report of the unidentified vessel did not help the captain, the Neimoidian vaguely recalled the importance of the craft. He ordered the [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] to obtain the threat files for their current sector. After reading the records of [[Head of State/Legends|Separatist leader]] [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku's]] brief stay as a captive of the [[Ohnaka Gang/Legends|local Weequay]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]], the Neimoidian rationalized that Dooku would want vengeance brought upon the pirates, and ordered the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] to [[Battle of Florrum|fire upon]] Alama's craft.<ref name="Hunting" />

Nearby, under the command of [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]] and [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Bly/Legends|CC-5052]], "Bly,"<ref name="Hunting" /> a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Aayla Secura's Acclamator-class assault ship|''Acclamator''-class assault ship]]<ref name="Gunship">{{SWArchive|url=games/playnow/gunship|text=Gunship Over Florrum|int=Gunship Over Florrum}}</ref> was performing a [[Scout/Legends|scouting]] mission. After watching the Separatist frigate engage the Weequay craft via [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]], Secura had Bly perform a quick reconnaissance, telling the [[Commander/Legends|commander]] to take a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i]] [[Gunship/Legends|gunships]] to determine the situation and only fire on the enemy if they were attacked first. One of the Republic gunships was spotted by the Separatist frigate; on the frigate's bridge, the droid lieutenant informed the Neimoidian of the enemy's presence. The captain ordered [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]]<ref name="Hunting" /> of [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture droids]], [[Hyena-class bomber/Legends|Hyena bombers]], and [[Single Trooper Aerial Platform/Legends|Single Trooper Aerial Platforms]]<ref name="Gunship" /> to attack the Republic craft. Noting that all of the dispatched forces were droids, he announced that he would not have to worry about sharing credit for what he presumed to be an imminent success.<ref name="Hunting" /> However, Bly's gunship dealt with the majority&mdash;if not all&mdash;of the droids dispatched, and the Republic craft also managed to shoot down Alama's ship, denying the Neimoidian captain his two victories.<ref name="Gunship" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Since you're all droids, you need not share in the rewards that will inevitably await my success!''"<br />"''Roger roger.|The Neimoidian and his battle droid lieutenant|<ref name="Hunting" />}}
Dressed in [[Color/Legends|purple]] [[Robe/Legends|robes]] and wearing a similarly colored miter, the Neimoidian was the commander of a Separatist frigate assigned to patrol duties in the Outer Rim. He believed that a good Neimoidian commander made his own opportunities. Holding a contemptuous attitude toward the droids under his command, the captain was almost continually finding fault in the reports of his battle droid lieutenant. He did not believe in sharing with them the glory that he believed he would receive after successfully dealing with both the Weequay pirates&mdash;who had previously held Confederate Head of State Count Dooku&mdash;and the Republic forces on reconnaissance in the area. The Neimoidian had green skin and red [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].<ref name="Hunting" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Neimoidian captain first appeared as an unidentified character in ''[[The Clone Wars: Hunting the Hunters (Part I)]]'', an [[Star Wars comic books|issue]] of the online [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (webcomics)|''The Clone Wars'' comic series]], taking place between [[The Clone Wars: Season One|seasons one]] and [[The Clone Wars: Season Two|two]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series.<ref name="Hunting" />
